theme.rationale: Medical and clinical workflows demand utmost contrast, crisp legibility and zero visual fatigue. Restrained luxury clinical palette: Deep Navy/Obsidian base, warm crisp slate backgrounds in light mode, high-density zinc/slate dark mode, precision teal/cyan kinetic accents.

typography.font_family_heading: Cabinet Grotesk, Manrope, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

visual_enhancers.card_style: 1px crisp border (border-border), no glossy gradients, subtle dark navy tinting, inner border glow on focus/selected states
visual_enhancers.ai_distinction_badge: Distinct emerald-teal hairline border with 'MOCK AI YANITI' or 'YAPAY ZEKA ASİSTANI' micro-capsule pill to ensure full regulatory and clinical transparency
visual_enhancers.evidence_card_style: Academic index citation card layout (Europe PMC / TR Dizin / Ulusal Kılavuzlar) with DOI, PMID, evidence level badge (Kanıt Düzeyi I-A / II-B) and verified checkmarks
visual_enhancers.empty_state_style: Minimalist geometric wireframe SVG with crisp instructions, keyboard shortcut tips
visual_enhancers.composer_style: Perplexity/Linear style expanded prompt input with quick action pills (Tedavi yaklaşımı, İlaç seçenekleri, Ayırıcı tanı, Tetkik önerileri), paperclip attachment, and circular send button

layout_architecture.sidebar: Collapsible 64px icon-only or 240px expanded navigation with workspace switcher (Özel Klinik, Acil Tıp Konsültasyon, Admin Workspace), physician badge, allowance counter (5/5 Ücretsiz Kullanım), theme toggle
layout_architecture.main_content: Full height responsive viewport with top bar breadcrumb, active workspace status, rapid global search trigger (⌘K / Ctrl+K), and physician verification pill
layout_architecture.clinical_workspace_split: Two-column 68% / 32% layout on desktop: Left side houses interactive conversation timeline + composer + quick prompts; Right side houses live case clinical parameters (şikâyet, yaş, cinsiyet, süre, alerjiler), quick İlaç Güvenlik Kontrolü trigger, and research export

routes_and_views.description: Action-oriented command center: 3 primary action cards (Yeni Klinik Araştırma, Kanıt Ara, İlaç Sorgula), recent clinical sessions, drafts ready for research, medication query history, and verification banner.

Interactive clinical investigation workspace. Step 1: Anonymized patient context modal/form (Şikâyet, Yaş, Biyolojik Cinsiyet, Süre, Alerjiler, Ek Bağlam). Step 2: 68/32 split screen with mock clinical AI reasoning, cited guidelines, evidence pills, and dynamic chat composer.

Medical literature & guidelines search engine. Filter by source (TR Dizin, Europe PMC, Sağlık Bakanlığı Kılavuzları, Cochrane). Displays abstract, sample citations, DOI/PMID, and clinical relevance score.
Comprehensive medication search over Türkiye pharmaceutical dataset (14,566 products / 4,035 active ingredients). Drug-drug interaction and allergy checker with 'Veri mevcut değil' fallback labels.
Historical clinical sessions, searchable and filterable by date, specialty tag, and status (Tamamlandı, Taslak, Arşivlendi).
Transparent tiers: 'Ücretsiz Deneme' (Aktif - 5 sorgu hakkı), 'Professional Hekim' (Yakında), 'Klinik & Kurumsal' (Yakında) with feature matrix.
Physician profile, Dip. Tescil No, Uzmanlık Alanı, and verification status state machine: 'İnceleniyor', 'Doğrulandı', 'Reddedildi'.
Admin workspace only visible when 'Yönetim / Admin' workspace is active. Manage physician verification queues, review uploaded diploma proofs, and monitor workspace allowance.

image_urls.description: Physician in lab coat holding stethoscope against dark background - used for doctor verification profile badge
Clinical research microscope laboratory - used for evidence discovery hero header card

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete UI in Turkish ('Ana Sayfa', 'Klinik Araştırma', 'Kanıt Ara', 'İlaçlar', 'Geçmiş', 'Paketler', 'Profil', 'Yönetim').
Provide a seamless Theme Toggle (Açık Mod / Koyu Mod) stored in localStorage and applied via Tailwind 'dark' class on documentElement.

Implement Workspace Switcher in the top/sidebar: 'Dr. Kerem Arslan (Kişisel)', 'Acil Servis Konsültasyon Grubu', and 'Yönetim / Admin Workspace'. The 'Yönetim' route is strictly visible or highlighted when in the Admin workspace.
Store all cases, search history, drug safety checks, drafts, and verification status in localStorage so the prototype persists seamlessly.
Ensure every mock AI answer is explicitly badged with '[MOCK AI YANITI - KLİNİK TAVSİYE DEĞİLDİR]' in Turkish for high medical integrity.
Include data-testid on every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, modal triggers, quick prompts).
